title: Studio
subtitle: Architecture & design
paragraphs: We are an architecture and design studio based in Erode, Tamil Nadu, working on homes, commercial buildings, hospitality and interiors across the state.
We believe good architecture comes from a close understanding of people and place. Every building we design responds to its site, its climate and the way its owners want to live and work.
We combine design sensitivity with careful technical detail, and our architects lead each project from the first site visit to handover.
